title: Event-Study Grid: Forward Markouts from Tradeable Anchors (with Amendment A10.1)
baseline: phase-6b-approved (master == tag == 295a0e1); event_minute_bars_v2 (45,925,350 rows); D1 = 15,763 events
summary: First forward-return measurement in the program. Scan-free: every quantity derives from event_minute_bars_v2 (0 passes over filtered_trades/filtered_quotes) + frozen 6b tick-anchor artifacts. Markouts are signed log returns from anchors knowable in real time. T1 decomposed realized(09:30). T2 ran the deferred ETH-split decay and the ARBB row-cap detector. T3 built participation baselines + quintiles. T4 constructed clock+rung anchors (ASOF last-trade-at/before); the 09:00 clock anchor tripped escalation row 7 at 11.04% anchor_undefined -> HARD STOP. Cooper approved Amendment A10.1 (2026-08-01): retain 09:00 with a population guard, raise row 7 to 15%, add flag_possible_row_cap. Resumed T4c-T7. T5 produced the markout grid; T6 the survivorship census.

decisions_log.decision: rth_open chosen as the flagship reference anchor
decisions_log.reason: neutral, universally-defined session-start decision point (98.7% defined); a reporting convention, not a markout-based selection (row 10)

a point mass in the selected logrv (many zero-premarket events at 0900) would collapse value-based qcut bins and drop events; rank guarantees 5 balanced buckets with full assignment ('only the rank is used')
a present baseline session with no premarket bars has a genuine 0 cumulative premarket volume, not undefined; undefined reserved for sessions with no bars (no_baseline)

decisions_log.decision: T6 trading-session calendar derived from v2's own trade timestamps
decisions_log.reason: neither calendar lib importable in this Python; the within-archive ET-date calendar is more defensible and keeps the banned federal-holiday calendar out of market logic

surprises: flagship rth_open->t0_close median markout DECLINES monotonically with rising pre-open participation quintile, in BOTH eras, with Q5 negative - the strongest structure in the grid, along participation not entry-timing
ETH-dominant events' median realized fraction never reaches 0.5 on the extended-day clock and actually falls after RTH open, while non-ETH climbs - a clean native split in the extended frame
ARBB lands on EXACTLY 100,000 and EXACTLY 50,000 T=0 prints on two different events; 8 D1 events total sit on {50k,100k,200k} - a near-confirmed collector row cap
the 1,740 no-premarket-print events are a distinct population at RTH open (higher, tighter markout to close) - the population guard was warranted
removing the 8 row-cap and 7 dup events barely moves the flagship median (<0.0002) - aggregate contamination is nil at n=8/7
